entries.definition: Central mythological identity associated with the Potato of Life and Father/source principle.
Central life-cycle and totality metaphor: buried, rooted, sprouting, manifesting, feeding, reproducing and returning.
Developing symbolic/religion-like framework centered on the Potato of Life, Tim, Father/Son relations, transformation and the North Axis.
Source/upper principle represented through Tim; associated with the Father's House and North of North.
Symbolic home/source/upper chamber of the Father.
Manifestation/descent archetype associated with Thomas, Twin, Son of Man, Lion and Door.
Twin/witness archetype connecting doubt, direct encounter, verification and the Son.
Threshold and interface between layers; symbolic narrow gate and Son transformation.
Container/interface through which a higher/source principle manifests in a lower field.
Vertical bridge between layers, associated with ascent, wisdom and the Axis.
Visible vertical manifestation of root, trunk, branch and fruit; complement to the underground Potato.
Divine/light metaphor expressed through Potato imagery.
Central orientation structure linking geography, hierarchy, source direction and the North Programme.
Transcendent direction beyond ordinary geographic North.
Seat/center of the northern source hierarchy.
Northern threshold into the Axis/source direction.
Creative, loving, light-seeking, outward/upward, sprouting and Life direction.
Memory, fear, meticulousness, inward/downward, root and Strife direction.
Expansion, sprouting, manifestation and creative continuation.
Friction, fear, contraction and preservation; potentially productive when integrated with Life.
Hidden ancestry, memory, past, soil and underground continuity.
Visible result, manifestation, nourishment and future consequence.
Recurrence with transformation rather than simple repetition.
Long-duration threshold used to exaggerate persistence, attention and cosmic time.
April 2025 symbolic transformation milestone in the mythology.
Symbolic death of a person/image into a meme and then a mythic archetype.
Transition from visible person/object into soil, memory and potential rebirth.
Material/low field from which dwellers and potatoes emerge.
A being whose perspective begins inside the material world and therefore sees only a partial slice of the whole.
Comic lower-order observer: loyal, vocal, embodied and limited in perspective.
Absurd image for entities beneath a hierarchy that nevertheless attempt to measure or judge the whole.
Cultivator of fields, growth and harvest.
Metaphor for cultivation, harvesting or management of consciousness and identity.
Layer of accumulated mud/shadow structures, later used for hidden political/institutional machinery.
Rejected/discarded channel motif; a shadow counterpart to the Door.
Bounded frame/box representing constrained dimensional experience.
Remote cosmic/bounded object motif associated with the Cube family.
Central line/structure around which vertical and horizontal relations are organized.
Sovereignty title used as a comparative mythic motif for supreme authority.
Biblical lineage/root motif used as symbolic language around the Son and sovereignty.
Strength, sovereignty, courage and transformation; compared with Lion of Judah imagery.
Sacrifice, vulnerability and innocence; complements the Lion.
Creation/cultivation field combining Edenic, agricultural and Potato imagery.
Foundational scripture-like concept intended to explain the Potato cosmology and its relationships.
Mythic ship/vessel image carrying Potato cosmology northward over an infinite mud sea.
Comic embodiment of impossible bookkeeping, debt, duration and cosmic order.
Smallest-unit attention test: the whole system must be able to care about one tiny part.
Dynamics of the still center: conditions, observation, learning, intervention and responsibility.
Bridge between symbolic geography/kingdom imagery and the empirical atlas.
Real-world policy/worldbuilding extension of the North Axis, anchored on Denmark and Greenland.
Relationship-first economic lens asking who owns, owes, funds, controls, supplies or depends on whom.
